newsitem.title: USA: U.S corp debt supply dries up as rates turn higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S corp debt supply dries up as rates turn higher.

text.p: A rise in U.S. Treasury yields following a strong batch of U.S. economic data is expected to keep corporate bond issuers sidelined on Friday, dealers said.

"I don't think we'll see much today in terms of issuance," said one high-grade syndicate official. "The (Treasury) market's been bouncing around a lot and that's going to take what ever steam their may have been out until next week."
A strong 58.6 reading in the manufacturing activity index of the the National Association of Purchasing Management pushed U.S. Treasury prices lower and the T-bond down over a point.
